Title: Insertion stuck on ReplicatedMergeTree when keeper connection lost.
Description: I setup a cluster with 2 nodes. each node run a clickhouse server as well as an embedded keeper.
If i shut down one node. The keeper node will fail because quorum is 2 and only 1 keeper alive.
In this case, ReplicatedMergeTree tables should be readonly on the remaining node.

But when I do insertion on the table. it never returns and stuck. Is this expected behavior?
